title: Production Learning & Autonomous Roadmap Renewal II
purpose: Review recorded 363–375 outcome instrumentation, name what remains unverified, and publish a bounded 377–390 queue without making new business, Finance, Auth or provider authority.

review_basis.source: Repository acceptance contracts and canonical management/workability/route/CRM/Finance/equipment/material/mobile read models; not a measured live Production sample
review_basis.data_quality: No live customer, payment, provider, payroll or production metrics were accessed to establish aggregate improvements
review_basis.confidence: Capability-level review only. Any missing, stale, permission-hidden, capped or sample-insufficient outcome remains unknown; never substitute zero or a claimed production effect.

learning_review.learning: Private source-keyed journal records review and outcome without rewriting the source item.
learning_review.remaining_gap: Assess follow-up completeness, late review, and recurrence with source coverage.

learning_review.learning: Read-only constraint-to-dispatch/production correlation separates recorded recovery from missing evidence.
learning_review.remaining_gap: Compare seasonal recovery rates over equivalent evidence windows.

learning_review.learning: Planned-vs-actual execution and stop-order evidence capture scheduling friction.
learning_review.remaining_gap: Aggregate repeated seasonal friction without assigning employee scores.

learning_review.learning: Recorded renewal/hold/churn outcomes are separated from pending or unobserved outcomes.
learning_review.remaining_gap: Track cohort retention and renewal lag with denominator confidence.

learning_review.learning: Recorded estimate-vs-actual and change-order evidence enables bounded variance review.
learning_review.remaining_gap: Separate mix changes from true estimate bias and unapproved extras.

learning_review.learning: Recorded completed, invoiced, and paid timestamps distinguish commercial handoff stages.
learning_review.remaining_gap: Identify aging bottlenecks without issuing invoices or collecting funds.

learning_review.learning: Payroll exception and work-hour capture evidence distinguish incomplete capture from zeros.
learning_review.remaining_gap: Measure exception closure and shift coverage without employee ranking.

learning_review.learning: Maintenance/downtime events and replacement context are source-backed and non-committal.
learning_review.remaining_gap: Identify repeated high-cost asset gaps without invented replacement ROI.

learning_review.learning: Planned vs actual use is comparable only with explicit compatible units.
learning_review.remaining_gap: Track stockout/overuse trends and unit-conversion evidence across seasons.

learning_review.learning: CRM follow-up completion, recorded replies and provider delivery are explicitly separate.
learning_review.remaining_gap: Measure queue aging without inferring customer intent or violating consent.

learning_review.learning: Data-quality signals join journal outcomes; capped/partial scans withhold absence-based closure.
learning_review.remaining_gap: Measure reappearance and evidence freshness by canonical signal.

learning_review.learning: Mobile read/payload/replay/refresh ceilings and local conflict-rate signals are guarded.
learning_review.remaining_gap: Compare privacy-safe release cohorts and safe resolution, never queued payloads.

learning_review.learning: Recorded 14-day season mix, shared crew-day, route headroom and permission-scoped profitability expose gaps.
learning_review.remaining_gap: Backtest mix constraints without mixing overlapping job and agreement profit populations.

prioritization.method: Prioritize verifiable operational outcome, canonical-source reuse, permission safety and low external dependency; preserve four-season applicability and mobile/offline bounds.

renewal_principles: Use only existing canonical Jobs, Safety, Equipment, Employment, CRM, Finance, Dispatch, Workability, Inventory and release-evidence authorities.
Spring/summer landscaping and lawn work, fall cleanup and leaf collection, winter snow/storm/ice work, and general four-season operations must stay visible.
Distinguish capability/source-contract evidence from real Production measured outcomes; no invented counts, improvement percentages, demand, prices, profits, or staff scores.
Keep missing, stale, capped, hidden and insufficient sample evidence explicitly unknown; preserve traceable denominators and windows.
Read-only/advisory learning cannot mutate Jobs, Safety, Equipment, Employment, CRM, Finance, scheduling, inventory or customer/provider commitments.
No ordinary item may depend on live payments, real customer messages, provider credentials, staging acceptance, or manual signoff.
Finance posting, external Auth changes, provider delivery, purchases, and destructive reconciliation remain fail-closed absent independent explicit authorization.
Every release must retain exact-source GitHub release proof, privacy, permissions, phone accessibility, offline conflict authority and production reconciliation.
By the final queued item, publish at least ten further autonomous bounded releases before promoting again.
